correctness.rationale: Each ordered unequal adjacent-letter boundary digram appears at exactly one phase, including q=2, so any equal nonmonochrome length-m factors would force the same phase. Equal factors at different phases are exactly monochrome inside the same run. Therefore the first possible index separation is the first modular distance not exceeding M-m; the phase-step orbit order is T=L/g. The subgroup minimum nonzero circular distance is gcd(L,m), giving sharp full-orbit threshold, and residue-class counting gives H. Cases m>=M, m>=L and T=1 are handled. Independent direct word enumeration checked 1692 configurations against both K and H, without extrapolating finite checks to arbitrary run lengths.

value.rationale: A natural tractable periodic word class has a complete uniform antipower profile and residue-sensitive phase census.
